originalPrompt: Integrate Asana MCP via Composio (OAuth2), i only need one tool call: Create task, which will enable me to create a task in My tasks.

utterances: Create a task in Asana to prepare the quarterly review slides
Add a todo in My Tasks in Asana: review design specs
Create a task in Asana: Finalize deployment checklist

sampleArgs.name: Prepare quarterly review slides
sampleArgs.notes: Include Q1 revenue metrics, product roadmap updates, and hiring plan.

sampleArgs.name: Finalize Q2 comprehensive infrastructure migration roadmap and cross-functional capacity planning documentation across engineering teams
sampleArgs.notes: Verify high-availability multi-region failover tolerances, evaluate Redis cluster memory ceilings, reconcile staging telemetry discrepancies, and confirm SOC2 audit trail compliance before board review on Thursday morning.

sampleData.name: Finalize Q2 comprehensive infrastructure migration roadmap and cross-functional capacity planning documentation across engineering teams
sampleData.notes: Verify high-availability multi-region failover tolerances, evaluate Redis cluster memory ceilings, reconcile staging telemetry discrepancies, and confirm SOC2 audit trail compliance before board review on Thursday morning.

stressCases.expected: Title clamps at 2 lines with ellipsis and notes clamp gracefully within the 8px-radius inner container without overflowing.

sampleData.error: Composio connection error: Asana OAuth connection not authorized. Re-authenticate in Composio Settings.

stressCases.expected: Quiet coral tinted error surface displaying the connection issue while preserving the Asana header and My Tasks hierarchy.
